value.rationale: The Heawood graph is a canonical highly symmetric nonplanar Fano incidence graph. A concrete generation result by 42 toric classes supplies a motivated nonplanar counterpart to the planar toric-class literature; its top homology has a distinct six-dimensional irreducible symmetry constituent invisible to Betti ranks. Both are structural, mathematically reusable invariants, not arbitrary slices.
